metaDescription: Review your current plan, subscription details, and upgrade options in Rawafid.

hero.title: Your plan & subscription
hero.description: See your current plan details — shipment volume, price, and validity dates. Plan changes are handled by the Rawafid team until self-serve checkout is available.

plan.priceHint: Price locked in at subscription time
plan.freeHint: Free plan with no end date

upgrade.title: Upgrade or change plan
upgrade.description: Plan changes are currently handled by the Rawafid team. Reach out and we will help you pick the right shipment volume for your store.
upgrade.freeDescription: You are on the free plan. When your shipment volume grows, our team can move you to a paid tier that fits.
benefits: Pick a shipment volume that matches your store
Monthly or yearly billing to suit your needs
Direct support from the Rawafid team
upgrade.mailBody:
Hi Rawafid team,

I would like to upgrade my plan or discuss subscription options.

Thank you.

notice.title: Snapshot of your current deal
notice.description: The prices and limits shown here reflect what was agreed when your subscription was activated. If platform plan pricing changes later, your details stay the same until your subscription is updated.
